stories.h: Tinubu, Atiku, Peter Obi and three others invited to presidential debate on 10 January
stories.p: A political group has announced a presidential debate in Abuja on 10 January 2027, six days before the election, inviting Tinubu, Atiku, Peter Obi, Seyi Makinde, Donald Duke and Adewole Adebayo.
body: Six presidential candidates have reportedly been invited to a policy debate in Abuja on 10 January 2027, six days before the presidential election.
## The announcement

The convener of the organising group, Lai Omotola, announced the plan at a press conference in Lagos on Friday, 20 November 2026. He said the debate is designed to push the candidates beyond campaign slogans and into detailed discussions of their policies.
## Who is invited

The six candidates invited are President Bola Tinubu of the APC, Atiku Abubakar of the ADC, Peter Obi of the NDC, Oyo Governor Seyi Makinde, former Cross River governor Donald Duke and the SDP's Adewole Adebayo.
## Will they attend?
It was not clear from the reports whether all the candidates have confirmed they will take part.

The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.

stories.h: Tinubu's praise singer Rarara mobbed at Abuja National Mosque
stories.p: Hausa praise singer Dauda Kahutu Rarara, a well-known supporter of President Tinubu, was attacked by an angry crowd at the Abuja National Mosque during Friday prayers. Security operatives struggled to hold the crowd back.
body: Popular Hausa praise singer Dauda Kahutu, widely known as Rarara, was attacked by an angry crowd at the Abuja National Mosque during Friday prayers on 20 November 2026.
## What happened

Rarara, a prominent supporter of President Bola Tinubu, was entering the mosque with plain-clothed and uniformed security personnel when a group of people rushed at him. Security operatives tried to hold the crowd back but could not fully contain them. At one point, the singer removed his cap, which carried Tinubu's insignia.
A video of the incident has spread widely online.
## Context

The incident came a week after President Tinubu's convoy was pelted with stones after Friday prayers at a mosque in Garki, Abuja, an attack for which police arrested 78 people before the Presidency directed their release.
## Reactions
Paul Ibe, media adviser to ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar, condemned the violence on X while also making a political point about the incident.

stories.p: Former Kogi Governor Yahaya Bello, who plans to contest the Kogi Central senatorial seat in 2027, has claimed his political reach far exceeds that of the sitting senator, Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan.

stories.p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi, speaking in Anambra alongside former Kano governor Rabiu Kwankwaso, has promised to fight corruption and use public money for the public good.
body: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has told supporters in Anambra State that Nigerians will feel a difference from the very first day if he and Rabiu Kwankwaso win the 2027 election.

Speaking in Anambra alongside the former Kano governor, Obi reportedly said their administration would prioritise accountability, transparency and the responsible management of public funds.
He said the two of them would fight corruption and make sure public money is used for the public good, adding that Nigerians would know from day one that a new team was in charge.

At an NDC town hall and rally at All Saints Anglican Cathedral in Onitsha on Friday, Obi also urged Nigerians to turn out in large numbers on 16 January 2027, stay at polling units until results are counted and transmitted, and guard against rigging. He said Nigerians should accept the result of any genuinely free and fair contest.

Obi's comments came a day after Anambra Governor Charles Soludo hosted an APC rally in Awka for President Bola Tinubu and said the election was already decided. ADC chieftain Dele Momodu responded that Obi would win Anambra comfortably.

stories.h: Fact check: Viral video claiming bandits attacked Tinubu is old and misleading
stories.p: A video shared on Facebook claiming bandits tried to attack President Tinubu is false. The footage reportedly dates back to a June 2025 incident in Kaduna and does not show a bandit attack.
body: A video circulating on Facebook since 27 October 2026, claiming that bandits attempted to attack President Bola Tinubu, has been found to be misleading.
## The claim

The video shows Tinubu speaking at a podium and flinching as a man runs beside him, while two uniformed soldiers move in to shield him. A caption on the clip reads that a bandit attacked the president, and a narrator repeats the claim.
## The facts

A fact-check found that the footage dates back to a June 2025 incident in Kaduna and does not show an attack by bandits. The video has been recirculated with a false caption ahead of the 2027 elections.
## Why it matters
Misleading videos and AI-generated images have become a growing concern in the 2027 campaign, with the main parties accusing each other of spreading false content online.

stories.h: At least 30 feared dead, about 300 missing as boat carrying mourners capsizes in Bayelsa
stories.p: At least 30 people are feared dead and about 300 missing after an overloaded boat carrying mourners to a burial capsized near Oweikorogha in Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa State. Police marine units are leading rescue efforts.
body: A boat said to be carrying more than 300 passengers has capsized in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State, with many people feared dead or missing.
## What happened
The boat was travelling from Ayama community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony when it capsized at about noon on Friday, 20 November 2026, shortly after passing Oweikorogha community.
The exact number of passengers on board and the number of casualties had not been established at the time of the reports, but residents fear several people may have lost their lives.
## Rescue efforts

The Bayelsa State Police Command spokesperson, DSP Musa Muhammad, confirmed the incident and said the Commissioner of Police had deployed the Marine Police Unit and the local divisional police officer for rescue operations. He said further details on casualties and missing persons would be released.
A former state chairman of the Maritime Workers Union also confirmed the incident.
## Death toll rises

Later reports put the number feared dead at at least 30, with around 300 others unaccounted for. Witnesses described the boat as heavily overloaded, and a community source said some people had raised concerns as passengers boarded.
## What happens next
Rescue and recovery efforts are continuing, and official casualty figures are expected once they are confirmed.
more: At least 30 are feared dead and about 300 missing.

stories.h: Ex-Super Eagles captain Segun Odegbami survives attack at his Abeokuta home
stories.p: Former Super Eagles captain Segun Odegbami says he fought off three armed men who broke into his home in Abeokuta in the early hours of Friday. Police say he has been treated and discharged from hospital.
body: Former Super Eagles captain and football administrator Segun Odegbami has survived an attack by three armed men who broke into his home in Abeokuta, Ogun State, in the early hours of Friday, 20 November 2026.
## What happened
The attackers reportedly overpowered his domestic staff and driver before forcing their way into his bedroom at about 2:30am. The 74-year-old was injured in the attack.

Odegbami described the incident as an attempt on his life. He said he fought back with help from his driver and house help, and the attackers eventually fled. He said it was the closest he had ever come to death.
## Police response
The Ogun State Police Command confirmed the attack and said the former international had been treated in hospital and discharged.
## Who he is
Odegbami is a former captain of the Super Eagles and one of Nigeria's best-known football figures.
## Manhunt ordered
Ogun State Commissioner of Police Bode Ojajuni visited Odegbami at his home and ordered an immediate manhunt for the attackers, promising they would be prosecuted once caught.

stories.p: A video of Bishop David Oyedepo saying church succession should be a spiritual process, not a family arrangement, has gone viral amid the Fountain of Life leadership crisis.

stories.h: Court rejects Atiku's bid to add new evidence to suit against Tinubu's eligibility
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has dismissed an application by Atiku Abubakar to introduce fresh evidence into his suit challenging President Tinubu's eligibility for 2027. The judge said the constitutional 14-day window had passed.
body: A Federal High Court in Abuja has thrown out an application by ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar to bring new evidence into his suit challenging President Bola Tinubu's eligibility to contest the 2027 election.
## The ruling

Justice Inyang Ekwo held that Section 285(9) of the Constitution allows only 14 days for evidence to be filed in a pre-election case. He found that Atiku's request to amend his originating summons would effectively bring in fresh evidence after that period had expired, which would breach the Constitution.
## The NYSC certificate

The suit challenges Tinubu's eligibility over the authenticity of his National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) discharge certificate. The judge upheld objections from President Tinubu, the APC and INEC, saying the proposed amendments went beyond clerical corrections and tried to bring in new facts, fresh claims of fraud and extra exhibits after the defendants had already responded.
## What it means
The ruling is a setback for Atiku's legal challenge, although the main suit itself was not decided in the reports. Atiku's camp had not responded publicly to the ruling in the reports.
## Background

Atiku is also involved in a separate legal battle over his ADC candidacy, after a court on 5 November voided the process that produced him as the party's candidate. INEC has said he will remain on its list until that dispute is settled.

body: FIFA President Gianni Infantino arrived in Warri, Delta State, on Friday, 20 November 2026, ahead of the commissioning of the rebuilt Warri City Stadium.

stories.h: Crypto firms given 30 November deadline to register for tax
stories.p: The Nigerian Revenue Service has told cryptocurrency exchanges and other virtual asset providers serving Nigerians to register on its new tax portal by 30 November or face sanctions.
body: The Nigerian Revenue Service (NRS) has given cryptocurrency exchanges and other virtual asset service providers until 30 November 2026 to register on its new tax portal or risk regulatory sanctions.
## Who is affected
The directive covers both local and foreign crypto businesses serving Nigerian customers, as the federal government moves to bring digital asset transactions under formal tax supervision.
## The deadlines
According to a public notice, operators must complete their initial registration by 30 November and connect their systems to the portal by 31 December 2026.
## Why it matters
The move is part of wider efforts to bring digital asset transactions under formal tax supervision.

stories.p: The Coalition for Democracy, which includes opposition parties linked to Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi and Seyi Makinde, has moved its second summit from 23 to 30 November. It said candidates' campaign schedules made the original date impossible.
body: The Coalition for Democracy, an alliance of opposition parties ahead of the 2027 elections, has reportedly postponed its second summit by one week.

The coalition's Central Leadership Committee announced on Friday, 20 November 2026, that the summit would now hold on Monday, 30 November, instead of Monday, 23 November.

The committee said the request came from member parties whose presidential candidates and campaign teams are busy with intensive campaigns across the country. It said it was more important for every party, presidential candidate and national chairman to attend than to keep the original date.
## Who is involved

The coalition brings together parties linked to ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar, NDC candidate Peter Obi and Oyo Governor Seyi Makinde. Member parties are expected to pause their nationwide campaigns to attend.

stories.h: Trump posthumously pardons baseball legend Pete Rose
stories.p: US President Donald Trump has granted a posthumous pardon to baseball great Pete Rose, who pleaded guilty to tax offences in 1990 and was banned from the sport for betting on games.
body: US President Donald Trump has granted a posthumous pardon to baseball legend Pete Rose, two years after his death.
## The pardon
Trump announced the pardon on Truth Social on Thursday, 19 November 2026, calling Rose a true baseball superstar and legend and praising his record of 4,256 career hits.
## His conviction

Rose, who died in 2024 aged 83, pleaded guilty in 1990 to two counts of filing false tax returns, admitting he failed to report $354,968 over four years. He was also given a lifetime ban from Major League Baseball after an investigation found he bet on games.
## Reinstatement
Rose, who played 24 seasons, was posthumously reinstated by MLB last year, making him eligible for the Baseball Hall of Fame. He remains the sport's all-time leader in career hits.

stories.h: Soludo says Tinubu doesn't need to rig 2027; Dele Momodu says Obi will beat him in Anambra
stories.p: Anambra Governor Charles Soludo told an APC rally in Awka that the 2027 election is already decided and Tinubu does not need to rig it. ADC chieftain Dele Momodu fired back that Peter Obi will win Anambra and embarrass the governor.
body: Anambra State Governor Charles Soludo and ADC chieftain Dele Momodu have clashed over the 2027 presidential race in Anambra, a day after Soludo's party, APGA, adopted President Bola Tinubu as its candidate.
## Soludo's claim

Speaking at the APC presidential campaign rally at Alex Ekwueme Square in Awka on Thursday, 19 November 2026, Soludo said the election was already won and lost and that President Tinubu does not need to rig it to secure a second term.
He argued that opposition candidates had strong support only in some parts of the country, while the Tinubu-Shettima ticket had a presence in every state.
## Momodu's response

Reacting the same evening on a television programme, Dele Momodu dismissed Soludo's prediction and said Peter Obi, the NDC candidate, would defeat Tinubu in Anambra and embarrass the governor. He pointed to Obi's 2023 performance, when he won both Anambra and Lagos States.
## Background

Anambra is Obi's home state, where he served as governor. APGA, which controls the state, formally adopted Tinubu as its candidate on Thursday, with Soludo handing the party's flag to Vice President Kashim Shettima.
## Tinubu's message

At the same rally, Vice President Kashim Shettima delivered a message on the President's behalf, saying no part of Nigeria can match the enterprise of the South-East and that the region's economic drive is vital to the country's competitiveness.
## The election
The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.

stories.h: US corrections officer accused of inviting another man home, then calling him an intruder and firing gun when boyfriend returned
stories.p: Lasacia Gore, a 34-year-old corrections officer in Michigan, has been charged with six felonies. Prosecutors say she invited another man to her home, then reported him as an intruder and fired a gun when her boyfriend came back unexpectedly. She has pleaded not guilty.
body: A 34-year-old woman in Michigan, United States, has been charged with six felonies after police say she invited another man to her home while her boyfriend was away, then reported him as an intruder when her partner returned unexpectedly.
## The 7am phone call

According to prosecutors, Lasacia Gore, a corrections officer with Wayne County, called police at around 7am on Monday, claiming an unknown man had broken into her home in Eastpointe and was fighting with her boyfriend.
But investigators say they found that she had invited the man over herself, and had even left the door unlocked for him.
## What police say happened
According to police, things turned violent when her boyfriend came home unexpectedly, found the visitor in the house and confronted him, leading to a fight.
Eastpointe Police Chief Corey Haines said Gore fired a gun while both men were wrestling on the kitchen floor. The bullet missed them and struck the wall above them.
## "You told me to leave the door open"

Macomb County Prosecutor Pete Lucido said the visitor's account contradicted hers. "She's making a call saying she doesn't know him and this and that, and he says, 'What are you talking about? You're the one who told me to leave the door open and I'm coming in!'" he said.
"It's crazy. This could have been very tragic and somebody could've died," Lucido added.
Chief Haines also expressed concern that a corrections officer was allegedly involved in making a false police report and firing a weapon.
## The charges
Gore faces six felony charges, including assault with a dangerous weapon, discharging a firearm at a building, filing a false felony report, lying to investigators and two firearm-related counts.

She pleaded not guilty at her arraignment on Wednesday. Her bond was set at $30,000, with a 10 per cent option. If released, she must stay at home under GPS monitoring, surrender her weapons and avoid contact with the complainant.
She is due back in court on 2 December for a probable cause conference. The charges are allegations and have not been proven in court.
## Over to you
How could a secret visit have gone so wrong, and what should happen to an officer accused of making a false report?

stories.h: UN top court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
stories.p: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority during the 2017 military crackdown. It is the first time the court has found a state responsible for genocide.
body: The International Court of Justice (ICJ), the United Nations' highest court, has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority during a military crackdown in 2017.
## The ruling

In a landmark judgment on Thursday, 19 November 2026, the court found Myanmar responsible for genocide in northern Rakhine State. The decision was reached by a 9-6 majority and marks the first time in the court's 80-year history that it has found a state responsible for committing genocide.
The court said genocidal intent was the only reasonable conclusion that could be drawn from the evidence before it.
## The case

The case was brought by The Gambia in 2019, accusing Myanmar of violating the 1948 Genocide Convention. The 2017 crackdown killed thousands of Rohingya and forced more than 700,000 to flee the country.
## Myanmar's position
Myanmar had denied the accusations, saying its forces were responding to attacks by armed groups.

stories.h: Hackers leak data of JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard customers
stories.p: Hackers have published the email addresses and phone numbers of 16,000 wealthy JPMorgan Chase customers after targeting third-party vendors. It is the second major cyber incident hitting the financial sector in a week.
body: Hackers have stolen and published personal information belonging to thousands of customers linked to JPMorgan Chase, Mastercard and Visa, in the second major cyber incident to hit the financial industry in a week.
## What was taken

JPMorgan Chase said the email addresses and phone numbers of about 16,000 of its wealthiest customers were published by a ransomware gang. The data appears to relate to the bank's invitation-only Reserve credit card, which usually requires customers to have more than $10 million in assets with the bank.
## How it happened

The bank said the hackers targeted third-party vendors that provide services to it. A Visa spokesperson said a service provider in the Asia-Pacific region was targeted, but that none of Visa's own systems were involved.
## What the bank is doing
JPMorgan said it would contact affected customers directly and offer support, including free credit monitoring.
## Wider trend
Earlier in the week, malicious code was planted on websites belonging to about 178 organisations after hackers exploited a flaw in a third-party web tool.

The plan was announced on Thursday, 19 November 2026, in a statement by the President's Special Adviser on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga. It is anchored on a new agreement with a bus manufacturer, with the first 100 buses expected to arrive soon.

stories.p: AI company Anthropic has reportedly raised $81.3 billion in its initial public offering, and $107.3 billion including a separate private sale. The deal values the company at about $1.5 trillion.
body: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has reportedly raised $81.3 billion through its initial public offering, ahead of its stock market debut.
## The numbers

The company, which makes the Claude chatbot, sold 980 million shares at $83 each, above its earlier range of $70 to $78. Including a separate $26 billion private share sale, its combined fundraising reached $107.3 billion, valuing it at about $1.5 trillion.
Its shares were scheduled to begin trading on the Nasdaq exchange in New York on Thursday, 19 November 2026, under the ticker ANT.
## A record?
The combined fundraising is more than the $86 billion raised when SpaceX went public in June, although the IPO alone was below that figure.
## Why it matters
The listing is being watched as a test of investor confidence in AI after a difficult fortnight for the industry. Anthropic makes much of its money selling AI services to businesses.

On its first day of trading, Anthropic's shares rose 17%, briefly valuing the company at about $2 trillion before closing at around $1.75 trillion. On Friday, the shares fell about 9.5% in early trading to around $88, still above the $83 IPO price. The company said its total IPO raise reached about $93.5 billion after underwriters bought extra shares.

body: Former Jigawa State Governor Sule Lamido has told Vice-President Kashim Shettima to be more careful with his public comments, saying the office of the Vice-President is "too big for jokes".

Lamido was reacting to a claim by Shettima that he now supports President Bola Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress (APC).
Lamido rejected the claim outright and distanced himself from the ruling party.

"Ikon Allah! I didn't join the APC in 2014, only to join now in 2026?" he said, using a Hausa expression of astonishment. "Even though it was a Kanuri man who said it, I'm not surprised. But in your local dialect, the answer is 'Kattuwunum!'"
## "Grow up"
Lamido described Shettima as intelligent and eloquent, but said the office of the Vice-President demands seriousness and restraint.
He also criticised some past remarks attributed to Shettima about former Vice-President Yemi Osinbajo, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar and former Senate President Ahmad Lawan.

Lamido, a veteran politician and two-term governor of Jigawa State, has long been a member of the opposition. His sharp response makes clear that, whatever claims are made, he is not switching sides ahead of 2027.

stories.h: Adamu Garba denies endorsing Peter Obi for 2027, says he has quit partisan politics
stories.p: Former APC presidential aspirant Adamu Garba has dismissed reports that he endorsed Peter Obi for the 2027 presidential election, saying he has withdrawn from partisan politics to focus on his businesses and Africa's digital economy.
body: Former All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential aspirant Adamu Garba has denied reports that he endorsed Peter Obi ahead of Nigeria's 2027 presidential election.
## "The claim is false"
In a public statement dated 18 November 2026, Garba described the claim circulating online as false.
He said he has withdrawn from partisan politics and is now focusing on his business ventures and on Africa's digital economy.
## His new focus
Garba named Crowwe, Tablars and Justitia SI among the projects currently receiving his attention.
He also urged the public to rely only on his official channels for accurate information about his activities.
## Where did the story come from?
The origin of the endorsement claim remains unclear. No post, interview or public statement showing Garba endorsing Obi has been found.
What is clear is that Garba has publicly disputed the claim.
## A familiar pattern

With the 2027 elections approaching, false claims about endorsements are spreading quickly on social media. It is the second time this week that a story about backing for Obi has been corrected, after Obi himself clarified that his Washington visit was not an endorsement from the US Congress.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan hospitalised in China with severe malaria, says it is his first hospital admission in 32 years
stories.p: Social media commentator VeryDarkMan says he is receiving treatment in a hospital in China after being diagnosed with severe malaria during a business trip. He said doctors told him he may stay for four to seven days.
body: Nigerian social media commentator Martins Vincent Otse, popularly known as VeryDarkMan (VDM), has disclosed that he is receiving treatment in a hospital in China after being diagnosed with severe malaria.
## The hospital video
VDM shared a video from a hospital bed on Thursday, 19 November 2026, lying in a hospital gown beside medical equipment.
He said he fell ill while on a business trip to China and at first tried to treat himself.
## "First admission in 32 years"

According to him, his condition got worse on Wednesday night, and he was taken to hospital the following morning. He said doctors told him he could remain under medical care for between four and seven days.
VDM added that this was the first time in 32 years that he had been admitted to hospital overnight.
## What we know

The video confirms that he was in a medical facility when it was recorded. However, no hospital document or statement from his doctors has been made public, so details of his diagnosis and treatment are based on his own account.
He did not name the hospital or the city where he is being treated.
## A reminder about self-medication

His experience is a reminder that malaria can become serious quickly, and that treating it at home without proper testing can be risky. Health experts advise anyone with symptoms to get tested and treated early.
## Over to you
Join us in wishing VDM a quick recovery. Have you ever tried to treat malaria yourself before going to hospital?

stories.h: Pochettino takes over at Manchester United, faces Liverpool in first game
stories.p: Mauricio Pochettino has reportedly arrived in England to take charge of Manchester United after the club sacked Michael Carrick. His first match is away at league leaders Liverpool, with United in the relegation zone.
body: Mauricio Pochettino has reportedly taken over as Manchester United manager, following the club's decision to sack Michael Carrick.
## His arrival
The Argentine flew into England on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, after his final game in charge of the United States men's national team.
## A tough start
His first match is a daunting one: a trip to Anfield to face league leaders Liverpool just five days after arriving. United are currently in the Premier League relegation zone.
A statistical model reportedly gives Liverpool a 57.3% chance of winning the game, with United at 20.5% and a draw at 22.2%.
## His first interview

In his first sit-down interview as head coach, the 54-year-old said changing the culture at the club is his top priority, stressing the need for a winning mentality and consistent daily habits. United are 18th with just eight points from their first 10 games, their worst top-flight start since 1984.
## Conte reacts

Antonio Conte, who had been linked with the job, rejected reports that United passed over him because of his demanding style, saying any club wary of his methods was afraid of winning. United reportedly paid a release clause to appoint Pochettino.
## Transfer plans

Reports have also linked Pochettino with transfer targets for January, with Nigeria defender Calvin Bassey said to be on his shopping list. Fulham are reportedly asking for around £50 million for the Super Eagles star.
## Background
Pochettino previously managed Tottenham, Paris Saint-Germain and Chelsea before taking the United States job.

stories.h: Cooking gas prices rise; refilling 12.5kg now costs up to ₦22,500
stories.p: Cooking gas has reportedly risen from about ₦1,400 per kg to between ₦1,500 and ₦1,800 depending on location. Some households are cutting back or switching to other fuels ahead of Christmas.
body: Nigerian households are facing fresh pressure as cooking gas prices rise across major cities ahead of the Christmas season.
## The new prices

The price of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) has reportedly risen from about ₦1,400 per kilogram to between ₦1,500 and ₦1,800, depending on location. That means refilling a 12.5kg cylinder can now cost as much as ₦22,500, up from about ₦17,500.
## How households are coping
Market findings suggest some Nigerians are now buying smaller quantities, cutting down on how much gas they use or switching to other cooking fuels.

stories.h: FG to release stored rice and maize to bring down food prices
stories.p: Agriculture Minister Abubakar Kyari says the government will release rice, maize and other grains from its stocks into the market to cut food prices. It also plans to distribute three million bags of fertiliser within a month.
body: The federal government has announced plans to release stored rice, maize and other grains into the market in a bid to bring down food prices.
## What was announced
Minister of Agriculture and Food Security Abubakar Kyari disclosed the plan on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, at the presentation of the 2026 Wet Season Agricultural Performance Survey Report in Abuja.
He said grains bought under the Bank of Agriculture's Guaranteed Minimum Price programme would soon be released to the market.
## Fertiliser for farmers
The government also plans to distribute three million bags of fertiliser to farmers within the next month to boost production and improve food supply across the country.
## Background
The Guaranteed Minimum Price scheme gives farmers an assured buyer for their produce.

stories.h: SDP's Adewole Adebayo vows to end Boko Haram in three months and cut petrol to ₦200
stories.p: SDP presidential candidate Adewole Adebayo has reportedly promised to defeat Boko Haram within three months and bring petrol down to ₦200 a litre if elected. He spoke at a rally in Yola.
body: Social Democratic Party (SDP) presidential candidate Prince Adewole Adebayo has reportedly promised to end the Boko Haram insurgency within his first three months in office if he wins the 2027 election.
## The rally
Adebayo made the pledge on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, at the SDP presidential campaign rally in Yola, Adamawa State, according to a statement from the party's campaign spokesman.

He blamed poor governance for the insecurity in the North-East, recalling the military campaigns to retake towns such as Mubi, Madagali, Michika, Gwoza and Bama, and argued that no government had properly dealt with the humanitarian fallout.
## Other promises
His plans reportedly include bringing petrol down to ₦200 per litre, expanding the use of CNG, affordable food, free education and better healthcare.
## The race
Adebayo is one of several candidates in the 16 January 2027 presidential election, alongside President Bola Tinubu (APC), Atiku Abubakar (ADC), Peter Obi (NDC) and others.

stories.h: Pastor Paul Eneche's sermon on unwanted leaders goes viral, seen as a jab at Tinubu
stories.p: A sermon by Pastor Paul Eneche saying leaders the people do not want should not contest has gone viral. Many on social media read it as aimed at President Tinubu ahead of 2027.
body: A sermon by Pastor Paul Eneche has gone viral, with many social media users interpreting it as a message aimed at President Bola Tinubu ahead of the 2027 election.
## What he said

In the clip, posted on Thursday, 19 November 2026, the cleric said a leader who is not wanted by the people has no business seeking or holding power. He argued that leadership should come from the genuine wishes of the governed, not from money or manipulation.
He questioned why anyone would spend money to impose themselves on people who do not want them, and said such people should not contest at all.
## Strong warning
He is also reported to have issued a warning to those he described as the architects of terrorism in Nigeria.
## Reactions

The clip spread quickly online. While Eneche did not name anyone in the portion widely shared, many viewers linked his remarks to the President. No response from the Presidency was included in the reports.

stories.h: Marathon world champion Peres Jepchirchir banned for three years for doping
stories.p: Kenya's Peres Jepchirchir, the reigning marathon world champion and Tokyo Olympic gold medallist, has been banned for three years after testing positive for EPO. Two other Kenyan runners were also banned.
body: Reigning marathon world champion Peres Jepchirchir of Kenya has been banned for three years for doping, the Athletics Integrity Unit (AIU) announced on Thursday, 19 November 2026.
## The ban
The 33-year-old, who also won Olympic gold at the Tokyo Games in 2021, was suspended after an out-of-competition sample showed traces of the banned blood booster EPO. Her ban runs from 20 October.
## Others banned

Two other Kenyan runners were also sanctioned. Veronica Loleo, a half marathon silver medallist at this year's World Road Running Championships, received three years for the same offence, while Ronald Korir, fourth at the 2023 Berlin Marathon, was banned for six years over abnormalities in his biological passport.
## A wider problem

They join more than 140 Kenyan athletes, including women's marathon world record-holder Ruth Chepngetich, who have been suspended or banned by the AIU since 2017. The AIU acknowledged that Kenyan authorities have made progress against doping but said these cases show there is still a long way to go.

stories.h: Naira falls to four-month low of ₦1,376 per dollar
stories.p: The naira has weakened to ₦1,376.58 per dollar in the official market, its lowest level since July. It closed at ₦1,363 on Wednesday and ₦1,430 on the parallel market.
body: The naira weakened against the US dollar in both the official and parallel foreign exchange markets on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, amid reduced foreign exchange inflows and rising demand for dollars.
## Official market

Data from the Nigerian Autonomous Foreign Exchange Market (NAFEM) showed the naira fell by ₦7.43, or 0.54%, to close at ₦1,363.23 to the dollar, from ₦1,355.80 the previous day. It also lost ground against the euro, closing at ₦1,495.60, but gained slightly against the British pound to ₦1,795.24.
## Parallel market
On the parallel market, the naira slipped by ₦10 to trade at ₦1,430 to the dollar, while at one major bank's foreign exchange desk it closed at ₦1,368.
## Why it matters
The fall comes a day after the naira lost about ₦25 against the dollar, and as the Central Bank of Nigeria and NNPC move to boost foreign exchange inflows.
## Four-month low

By Thursday, 19 November, official data showed the naira had fallen further to ₦1,376.58 per dollar, its weakest level since July 2026, raising concerns about exchange rate stability ahead of the end-of-year trading season.

stories.h: Video of RMD appearing to ignore man's selfie request sparks debate
stories.p: A viral video shows Nollywood veteran Richard Mofe-Damijo appearing to ignore a man who tried to take a selfie with him at a Lagos conference. The clip has divided opinion online.
body: A video of Nollywood veteran Richard Mofe-Damijo, popularly known as RMD, appearing to ignore a man who tried to take a selfie with him has gone viral.
## What the video shows

The footage, which began circulating on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, was recorded at a conference at the Muson Centre in Lagos. Inside the hall, RMD appeared relaxed, laughing and chatting warmly with the same man.

But once they stepped outside, the man reached out for a selfie and the actor turned away and busied himself with something else. Comedian Ali Baba, who was nearby, had stepped back to give the man space for the photo, which made the moment more noticeable.

The clip quickly spread online and sparked debate.

stories.h: Biola Adebayo puts new salon up for sale weeks after opening it
stories.p: Actress Biola Adebayo says she is selling her newly opened salon because her sister, who was meant to run it, has been granted a Canadian visa. She said she cannot manage the business herself.
body: Nollywood actress Biola Adebayo has announced that she is putting her newly opened salon up for sale, only weeks after unveiling it.
## The reason
In a video on her social media page, Biola explained that she set up the salon to give her sister, who had been going through a difficult time, a business of her own to run.
However, just days after the salon was unveiled, her sister received approval for a Canadian visa she had been waiting for for more than three years, and will now be relocating.
## Mixed feelings
The actress described the visa as good news, but admitted it left her with the challenge of managing the salon herself, which led to her decision to sell it.

stories.h: FG selects eight startups for over ₦1 billion iDICE funding
stories.p: The federal government has named eight Nigerian startups to receive about ₦134 million each in equity investment under the iDICE programme. They will also get mentorship and business support.
body: The federal government has unveiled eight Nigerian startups selected to receive about ₦134 million each under the Investment in Digital and Creative Enterprises (iDICE) programme.
## The funding

The companies will share a combined investment of more than ₦1 billion through Growth Lab, the second phase of the iDICE Startup Bridge initiative. Each startup will receive $100,000 in equity investment, along with business development support, mentorship and access to industry experts.
## The aim

The programme is designed to help Nigerian entrepreneurs grow their businesses, create jobs and compete more effectively in the digital and creative economy, and to help the startups attract further investment.

stories.p: Songs by Burna Boy and Asake are reportedly featured in Grand Theft Auto VI, which launches on 19 November. They are part of AfroBank FM, an in-game station dedicated to African sounds, with Burna Boy also a co-host.

stories.h: FIFA appoints normalisation committee to run NFF, names Amokachi and Enakhena
stories.p: FIFA has named lawyer Sampson Ebomhe to chair a normalisation committee for the Nigeria Football Federation ahead of its 2027 elections. Daniel Amokachi, Godwin Enakhena, Amina Yerima and Joe Abah are also members.
body: FIFA has set up a normalisation committee to run the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF), appointing lawyer Sampson Ebomhe as chairman with immediate effect.

The world governing body named four other members: sports journalist and administrator Godwin Enakhena, former Super Eagles captain Daniel Amokachi, Amina Yerima and Dr Joe Abah, former Director-General of the Bureau of Public Service Reforms.

FIFA's Chief Member Associations Officer, Elkhan Mammadov, confirmed the appointments in a letter, noting that all members are still subject to an eligibility check by the FIFA Review Committee before they are formally confirmed.
## Background

stories.h: Super Eagles climb to 29th in FIFA rankings despite Tanzania draw
stories.p: Nigeria have moved up one place to 29th in the latest FIFA world rankings and are back in Africa's top five. The boost comes despite the goalless draw with Tanzania that hurt their AFCON hopes.
body: Nigeria's Super Eagles have moved up one place to 29th in the latest FIFA world rankings, ending their 2026 international calendar with a small boost.
## The ranking
The Super Eagles climbed from 30th to 29th in the world and moved back into Africa's top five, after slipping out of that group earlier in the year.
## The results behind it

Nigeria beat Tanzania 3-1 in Uyo before playing out a goalless draw in the return leg in Zanzibar. The draw left them on seven points, three behind group leaders Guinea-Bissau, making their path to AFCON 2027 more complicated.

stories.h: Cement hits ₦15,000 a bag, up over 300% in five years
stories.p: A 50kg bag of cement now reportedly costs between ₦13,000 and ₦15,000, up about 329% from 2021 prices. Homebuilders and small developers are the hardest hit.
body: The price of a 50kg bag of cement in Nigeria has reportedly reached between ₦13,000 and ₦15,000, about 329% higher than in 2021, according to market price data.
## How prices rose

A bag cost between ₦3,300 and ₦3,500 in 2021, rising to about ₦4,600 in 2022 and ₦5,000 in 2023. By 2024 buyers were paying ₦7,500 to ₦8,500, and prices climbed to ₦9,500 to ₦10,500 through most of 2025. There was brief relief at the start of 2026 before prices rose again.
## Who is affected
The steep increase has put heavy pressure on construction budgets, hitting individual homebuilders and small-scale developers hardest.

stories.h: Anthony Joshua welcomes baby girl, says he will give up video games
stories.p: Boxer Anthony Joshua has welcomed a baby daughter with his childhood sweetheart Nicole Osbourne. He said surviving last year's car crash in Nigeria made him want to bring new life into the world.
body: British-Nigerian heavyweight boxer Anthony Joshua has welcomed a baby girl with his childhood sweetheart, Nicole Osbourne.
## What he said
Joshua said the baby arrived about three weeks earlier than expected. He explained that nearly losing his life last Christmas pushed him to make a deliberate choice to bring new life into the world.

The 35-year-old, who already has an 11-year-old son, JJ, said the couple did not find out the baby's sex during the pregnancy, so having a daughter was a surprise. He spoke warmly about becoming a girl dad.
## A new focus

The baby was born on 14 November 2026. Joshua described her birth as a big blessing and said he is ready to swap video games and motorcycles for tea parties and nail polish. He said he plans to be fully involved in her daily life, from choosing outfits to changing nappies, and that having a daughter has already made him reflect on how to be more understanding and supportive.
## Background
Joshua survived a car crash on the Lagos-Ibadan expressway in Nigeria late last year that killed two of his friends and trainers, Latif Ayodele and Sina Ghami.
## What's next
The birth comes ahead of his planned bout with Tyson Fury.

stories.p: A Shariah court in Kano has reportedly sentenced a 19-year-old TikTok user to five months in prison and 10 strokes of the cane after she pleaded guilty to insulting the Hisbah Board and its commander. Two other defendants pleaded not guilty.
body: A Shariah court in Kano State has reportedly sentenced a 19-year-old TikTok user, Zainab Abubakar, to five months in prison and 10 strokes of the cane for insulting the state Hisbah Board and its commander, Malam Aminu Ibrahim Daurawa.

stories.h: FG, states and councils share ₦2.44 trillion October revenue
stories.p: The Federation Account Allocation Committee has shared ₦2.441 trillion from October 2026 revenue among the federal, state and local governments. Both oil-related revenue and VAT dipped slightly from September.
body: The Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) has shared ₦2.441 trillion from October 2026 revenue among the federal government, states and local government councils.
## The breakdown

According to a statement on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, from the Office of the Accountant-General of the Federation, the pool was made up of ₦1.688 trillion in statutory revenue and ₦752.488 billion from Value Added Tax (VAT).
The federal government received ₦856.065 billion, the states ₦809.909 billion and local government councils ₦568.701 billion. A further ₦206.384 billion made up the rest of the pool.
## Revenue dips

Total gross revenue for October was ₦3.811 trillion. Gross statutory revenue fell by about ₦97 billion to ₦2.999 trillion, compared with September, while gross VAT revenue dipped slightly to ₦812.446 billion. Around ₦128.8 billion was deducted as cost of collection and ₦1.241 trillion for transfers, refunds and savings.
